Most users perceive time records as "stamping" and controlling employees. From the employee's point of view, this is indeed true, but for the company, working time records bring advantages.



The modern MiniOffice system brings advantages to both the company and the employees.



Different recording methods
In the nearly five years of operation of the MiniOffice system, one of the biggest advantages has been the flexible recording option. Namely, the system enables registration via a fixed recorder, mobile device, SMS, website. It is important that all data is collected



Data always and everywhere
For the company, the main fact is that the view into the current state of the employees ignores the method of always-possible recording. It also eliminates the need for security and archiving, as a cloud solution takes care of everything.



Presence does not mean effectiveness
The eTM system also allows monitoring of the time used. Performance is monitored with work assignments and tasks, which can also serve as a basis for billing or an invoice for the client's service. Switching on and off tasks can be easily done via the web interface at the workplace or via special control points in production. Identification of persons is carried out with pendants or cards, choice
done with a barcode.



Benefits for employees
Employees are usually the ones who are most skeptical about the introduction of working hours. The skepticism probably stems from the fact that in the past the system was often introduced only to control employees.



With the MiniOffice system, employees gain:

Up-to-date insight into data, number of hours, leave balance, schedule, daily regime.
Various recording methods (mobile devices, SMS...).
Electronic permits (permits, exits, corrections, travel orders, ...).
Online portal https://minioffice.si, where they can monitor and edit their personal profile.


Advantages for accounting
The system enables an automatic way of recording overtime in various allowances. It is possible to set different rules regarding the calculation of regular work and morning income. The system allows you to set fixed schedules or you can automatically select schedules based on arrival. Import payroll data into the most commonly used accounting system
possible via more than ten connectors.


Accounting benefits
The company cannot imagine modern evidence without electronic permit systems. Employees can thus request vacations, various outings, business trips and corrections to registration (forgot to register, etc.) by e-mail. When the superiors approve the electronic permit, the information is also updated. Notification can be via e-mail or SMS messages.

Predstavljamo vam mobilno aplikacijo najbolj obiskanega poslovnega imenika v Sloveniji, bizi.si.

Da boste pravočasno seznanjeni s poslovnimi in finančnimi informacijami o svojih poslovnih partnerjih in konkurentih, vam bizi.si omogoča pregleden in hiter vpogled v poslovanje več kot 130.000 slovenskih podjetij.

Bizi.si aplikacija omogoča dnevno spremljanje blokad TRR-jev, objav stečajev, likvidne sposobnosti in bonitetnih ocen podjetij, s čimer zagotavlja večjo varnost in uspešno poslovanje. Na hiter in enostaven način preverite poslovne sposobnosti slovenskih podjetij, dostopajte do ažurnih kontaktnih podatkov in uporabite zemljevid, kateri omogoča enostavno načrtovanje dnevnih obiskov pri vaših strankah ali pa zgolj lociranje iskanega podjetja.

Z mobilno aplikacijo so vam informacije o podjetjih na voljo vedno in povsod – doma, na poti, v službi in celo na dopustu.

Bizi.si mesečni dostop 
 
Bizi.si mesečni dostop je mesečna naročnina na dnevno obveščanje o spremembah vaših priljubljenih podjetij in dnevno osvežene podatke o blokada računov podjetij, objav sodišč, postopkov insolvetnosti ter njihovih finančnih podatkov.
 
S potrditvijo nakupa bo plačilo opravljeno z uporabo vašega iTunes računa. Cena mesečne naročnine je 9,99 EUR. Naročnina se avtomatsko podaljša vsak mesec. Naročnino lahko prekinete najkasneje 24 ur pred iztekom, sicer se avtomatsko podaljša. Prekinitev naročnine lahko izvedete kadarkoli v uporabniških nastavitvah telefona (iTunes & App Store > Account). Prekinitev tekoče naročnine ni možna, ampak začne prekinitev veljati z naslednjim obdobjem.

Splošni pogoji so dosegljivi na http://www.bizi.si/splosni-pogoji/
